Another idea is to get creative with what you already have at home. Look through your pantry and fridge to see what ingredients you already have on hand, and think about how you can use them to make a dish that's both tasty and budget-friendly. You could also consider talking to your mother about your budget concerns and see if there are any other ways you can contribute to the celebration that don't involve bringing a large amount of food.
